notes: All six E5 floors share one drawing frame (tools/floorplan-tracer/common.py: same scale and crop for every floor), so one transform serves them all.
Control points are the four corners of the main building body, read from the traced floor 3 outline and matched to OpenStreetMap way 51125806. They are not surveyed points.

Orientation evidence: the E3 bridge link (room 3818) leaves the drawing at the bottom-right, and E3 lies south-west of E5, so the right edge of the drawing is the south end and the bottom edge is the west wall.
Scale cross-check: the drawing's stated 1:300 scale gives 0.0346 m/pixel; the fit should land within a few percent of that.
To promote this to human_reviewed, replace the corner estimates with control points measured on site or from a georeferenced CAD export.
